summary.result: The experimental results show that, regardless of the type of fly ash, the penetration depth decreases and the shear wave velocity increases with the setting time.
summary.background: In this study, shear wave monitoring and Vicat needle test are performed to investigate the early-age properties of CLSM depending on the setting time.
summary.method: Five fly ashes with different chemical properties are used for CLSM samples.
